Class Shader

java.lang.Object
pl.AWTGameEngine.objects.render.shaders.Shader
Direct Known Subclasses:
BillboardShader, DefaultShader, GUIShader, XRayShader
public abstract class Shader extends Object
Shader class is used to create custom shaders. Every shader instance is a singleton in window area. To obtain shader, use Shaders.of(BaseWindow, Class).
You can use helper methods, such as setFloatValue(int, float) or setFloatMatrixValue(int, float[]), or just use GL context.
For reference, check out DefaultShader or XRayShader shaders.
Shader is compiled before its first use.
Vertex shader layout: 
 
 layout(location = 0) in vec3 aPos;
 layout(location = 1) in vec3 normal;
 layout(location = 2) in vec2 aUV;
